phase_name: Sample Phase 1 - Public Data Scope / Decision-Grade Only
allowed_output_families: Phase 1 may produce Decision-grade public-data findings, prioritization candidates, and validation questions.
forbidden_output_families: Phase 1 must not claim site verification, regulatory compliance closure, or validated savings.
Public-data proxy signals must not be converted into hard site claims.
escalation_boundaries: No claim may be upgraded from Decision-grade to Verification-grade without an explicit hardening route.
semantic_overreach_rules: Benchmark evidence must not be rewritten as site-specific proof.
evidence_traceability_expectations: Claims derived from public data must preserve visible source lineage.
